svg.title: Eight tables explain the station.
svg.desc: users • customers • products • delivery_staff: Users sign in; riders are separate operational records. Products store unit_price, delivery_price, stock and status. Customer records carry contact/address and archive state.; orders → order_items → products: An order references customer, creator and optional rider. Items retain quantity, saved unit price and line amount. Customer/product descriptions are read from current rows.; customers → payments / container_ledger: Payments reduce customer-level debt; no invoice allocation. Ledger counts Borrowed / Returned; optional order link. Timestamps are paid_at and moved_at respectively.; Keys connect records; calculations give balances: Unique username, product name and customer name/contact. Order-item parent deletion cascades; archive used records. Schema constraints do not recompute all aggregate totals.
svg.text: AQUATRACK3-GPT-CLAUDE_1 / FIELD GUIDE
Eight tables explain the station.
Source-based instructions • Open the SVG to zoom • Read the full README
01 IDENTITIES / CATALOG
users • customers • products • delivery_staff
Users sign in; riders are separate operational records.
Products store unit_price, delivery_price, stock and status.
Customer records carry contact/address and archive state.
02 SALES
orders → order_items → products
An order references customer, creator and optional rider.
Items retain quantity, saved unit price and line amount.
Customer/product descriptions are read from current rows.
03 LATER ACTIVITY
customers → payments / container_ledger
Payments reduce customer-level debt; no invoice allocation.
Ledger counts Borrowed / Returned; optional order link.
Timestamps are paid_at and moved_at respectively.
04 RELATIONSHIPS / LIMITS
Keys connect records; calculations give balances
Unique username, product name and customer name/contact.
Order-item parent deletion cascades; archive used records.
Schema constraints do not recompute all aggregate totals.
Java Swing • JDBC • MySQL | Source: uploaded Aquatrack3-gpt-claude_1
